[level-up] Level Up 3-3-3 | NPK 3 - 3 - 3 | All-round balanced growth
  About: Level Up 3-3-3 is a premium organic dry amendment that promotes strong roots, lush foliage, and vigorous growth with balanced nutrition for vegetables, flowers, and herbs. Available in multiple sizes, its resealable bag keeps the blend fresh, making it a reliable choice for beginner and experienced gardeners seeking organic results. Made from humic acid, alfalfa meal, kelp meal, crab meal, basalt rock dust, bone meal, blood meal, K-mag (langbeinite) and oyster shell flour.
  How to use: Use 1 tbsp per gallon of soil or coco. For mature plants, use 2 tbsp per gallon. Use 1/2 tbsp for seedlings.
  Sizes: 2 lb (0.9 kg); 5 lb (2.3 kg); 10 lb (4.5 kg) = 2 x 5 lb bags; 20 lb (9.1 kg) = 4 x 5 lb bags
  Prices (CAD, before tax and shipping): 2 lb $17.99, 5 lb $32.98, 10 lb $65.96, 20 lb $131.92

[flower-power] Flower Power 2-6-4 | NPK 2 - 6 - 4 | For blooms and bigger yields
  About: Flower Power 2-6-4 is a premium organic dry amendment that promotes strong roots, lush growth, and vibrant blooms in indoor and outdoor flowering plants. Its nutrient-rich formula supports abundant flower production, with easy application and clear instructions for gardeners of all experience levels. Made from alfalfa meal, bone meal, soft rock phosphate, KMS, glacial rock dust, kelp meal, oyster shell flour, gypsum and azomite.
  How to use: Use 1 tbsp per gallon of soil or coco. For mature plants, use 2 tbsp per gallon. Use 1/2 tbsp for seedlings.
  Sizes: 2 lb (0.9 kg); 5 lb (2.3 kg); 10 lb (4.5 kg) = 2 x 5 lb bags; 20 lb (9.1 kg) = 4 x 5 lb bags
  Prices (CAD, before tax and shipping): 2 lb $17.99, 5 lb $32.98, 10 lb $65.96, 20 lb $131.92

[crab-meal] Crab Meal 4-3-0 | NPK 4 - 3 - 0 | Root and pest protection, plus calcium
  About: Crab meal is an organic dry amendment made from crab & lobster shells, providing nutrients that support healthy soil & flower and vegetable growth. The NPK ratio of crab meal is 4-3-0, with a high concentration of nitrogen, phosphorus, and magnesium, and it is particularly rich in chitin.
  How to use: Apply in spring and every 2–3 months. Use 1–2 teaspoons per gallon of soil. Yellow leaves may indicate nitrogen deficiency.
  Sizes: 2 lb (0.9 kg); 5 lb (2.3 kg); 10 lb (4.5 kg) = 2 x 5 lb bags; 20 lb (9.1 kg) = 4 x 5 lb bags
  Prices (CAD, before tax and shipping): 2 lb $18.99, 5 lb $34.99, 10 lb $69.98, 20 lb $139.96

[blood-meal] Blood Meal 12-0-0 | NPK 12 - 0 - 0 | Fast nitrogen for green growth
  About: Blood meal is a dry powder made from animal blood byproducts and used as a high-nitrogen organic amendment. With an NPK ratio of 12-0-0, it is nitrogen rich. This fast-release amendment may take a month to show results.
  How to use: Apply in spring and every 2–3 months. Use 1–2 teaspoons per gallon of soil. Yellow leaves may indicate nitrogen deficiency.
  Sizes: 2 lb (0.9 kg); 5 lb (2.3 kg); 10 lb (4.5 kg) = 2 x 5 lb bags; 20 lb (9.1 kg) = 4 x 5 lb bags
  Prices (CAD, before tax and shipping): 5 lb $26.99, 10 lb $53.98, 20 lb $107.96

[bone-meal] Bone Meal 4-10-0 | NPK 4 - 10 - 0 | Phosphorus for roots, blooms and fruit
  About: Bone meal is an organic dry amendment made from ground animal bones, rich in phosphorus to support strong roots & healthy plant growth. It also provides calcium, iron, magnesium, and zinc, helping promote healthy stems, leaves, flowers, seeds and fruit production.
  How to use: Apply 1–2 tablespoons per gallon of soil. Mix in and water lightly. Nutrients release over 4 months.
  Sizes: 2 lb (0.9 kg); 5 lb (2.3 kg); 10 lb (4.5 kg) = 2 x 5 lb bags; 20 lb (9.1 kg) = 4 x 5 lb bags
  Prices (CAD, before tax and shipping): 2 lb $11.49, 5 lb $20.89, 10 lb $41.78, 20 lb $83.56

[kelp-meal] Kelp Meal 1-0-4 | NPK 1 - 0 - 4 | Ocean minerals for stress and root growth
  About: Kelp is a marine algae sourced from nutrient-rich oceans. Often combined with fish products, it promotes healthier plant growth, improves yields, & enhances garden quality. With an NPK ratio of 1-0-4, kelp meal releases nutrients quickly and provides over 70 vitamins and minerals, including essential micronutrients and macronutrients.
  How to use: Mix 1–2 tbsp per gallon of soil. Apply monthly during the growing season.
  Sizes: 2 lb (0.9 kg); 5 lb (2.3 kg); 10 lb (4.5 kg) = 2 x 5 lb bags; 20 lb (9.1 kg) = 4 x 5 lb bags
  Prices (CAD, before tax and shipping): 2 lb $15.99, 5 lb $32.99, 10 lb $65.98, 20 lb $131.96

[alfalfa-meal] Alfalfa Meal 3-0.5-3 | NPK 3 - 0.5 - 3 | Gentle nitrogen and a growth boost
  About: Enhance your garden with Alfalfa Meal, an organic dry amendment and soil conditioner rich in nutrients that promote healthy plant growth. Made from fermented alfalfa seeds, it has a light texture and pleasant earthy aroma. Apply generously around flowering perennials and shrubs.
  How to use: Mix 2 tbsp per gallon of soil. Apply around plants and hedges, mix into soil, and water. Apply in spring; repeat every 6 weeks for long-blooming plants.
  Sizes: 2 lb (0.9 kg); 5 lb (2.3 kg); 10 lb (4.5 kg) = 2 x 5 lb bags; 20 lb (9.1 kg) = 4 x 5 lb bags
  Prices (CAD, before tax and shipping): 2 lb $12.99, 5 lb $23.99, 10 lb $47.98, 20 lb $95.96

[feather-meal] Feather Meal 11-0-0 | NPK 11 - 0 - 0 | Slow nitrogen for lush leaves
  About: Feather meal is an organic dry amendment made from poultry feathers, processed under high heat and pressure, then finely ground into a nutrient-rich powder. With an NPK ratio of 11-0-0, it provides essential nitrogen for plant development, particularly during the vegetative stage, through both immediate and slow-release nutrition.
  How to use: Apply 1–2 tablespoons per gallon of soil or coco. Mix in and water thoroughly. Avoid overapplication.
  Sizes: 2 lb (0.9 kg); 5 lb (2.3 kg); 10 lb (4.5 kg) = 2 x 5 lb bags; 20 lb (9.1 kg) = 4 x 5 lb bags
  Prices (CAD, before tax and shipping): 2 lb $13.49, 5 lb $24.99, 10 lb $49.98, 20 lb $99.96

[soft-rock-phosphate] Soft Rock Phosphate 0-3-0 | NPK 0 - 3 - 0 | Slow phosphorus and calcium
  About: Soft rock phosphate is a natural mineral amendment derived from fossilized marine organisms formed millions of years ago. It provides slow-release phosphorus, silicon, boron, and trace minerals, improving soil fertility and retaining calcium around plant roots for healthier growth.
  How to use: Apply 1 cup per plant at planting or early in the season. For gardens, use 10 lbs per 100 square feet monthly. For containers, mix 2 tbsp per gallon of soil.
  Sizes: 2 lb (0.9 kg); 5 lb (2.3 kg); 10 lb (4.5 kg) = 2 x 5 lb bags; 20 lb (9.1 kg) = 4 x 5 lb bags
  Prices (CAD, before tax and shipping): 2 lb $11.99, 5 lb $21.99, 10 lb $43.98, 20 lb $87.96

[gypsum] Gypsum | NPK Soil amendment | Loosens clay, adds calcium and sulfur
  About: Gypsum is a natural mineral rich in calcium and sulfur, helping improve water absorption, reduce soil erosion, and support plant growth. It has little effect on soil pH but helps roots grow by reducing aluminum toxicity, especially in acidic soils, promoting healthier development.
  How to use: Use 1–2 tbsp per gallon of soil or coco. For foliar spray, mix 1/2–1 tsp per gallon of water and spray leaves evenly. For soil drench, mix 1–2 tbsp per gallon of water.
  Sizes: 2 lb (0.9 kg); 5 lb (2.3 kg); 10 lb (4.5 kg) = 2 x 5 lb bags; 20 lb (9.1 kg) = 4 x 5 lb bags
  Prices (CAD, before tax and shipping): 2 lb $11.49, 5 lb $20.89, 10 lb $41.78, 20 lb $83.56

[oyster-shell-flour] Oyster Shell Flour | NPK Soil amendment | Slow calcium and a steady pH
  About: Oyster shell flour contains 96% calcium carbonate and micronutrients, providing slow-release nutrition while helping maintain balanced soil pH levels. Its gradual breakdown provides lasting calcium, reducing the risk of nutrient lockout and supporting consistent nutrient availability for healthier plant growth.
  How to use: New pots: 1–2 tbsp per gallon of soil. Established plants: 1 tbsp per gallon. Base mixes: 1 cup per 30 L. Garden beds: 2.5–5 lbs per 100 square feet, mixed into the top 3 inches of soil.
  Sizes: 2 lb (0.9 kg); 5 lb (2.3 kg); 10 lb (4.5 kg) = 2 x 5 lb bags; 20 lb (9.1 kg) = 4 x 5 lb bags
  Prices (CAD, before tax and shipping): 2 lb $11.49, 5 lb $20.89, 10 lb $41.78, 20 lb $83.56

[dolomite-lime] Dolomite Lime | NPK Soil amendment | Raises pH, adds calcium and magnesium
  About: Dolomite lime is a natural mineral amendment containing calcium and magnesium, essential nutrients that support healthy soil and plant growth. Rich in calcium and magnesium carbonates, it helps balance soil pH, reduce acidity, and improve nutrient availability for healthier plants and gardens.
  How to use: Use 1–2 tbsp per gallon of soil. To raise soil pH from 5.5 to 6.5, use approximately 5 lbs per 100 square feet.
  Sizes: 2 lb (0.9 kg); 5 lb (2.3 kg); 10 lb (4.5 kg) = 2 x 5 lb bags; 20 lb (9.1 kg) = 4 x 5 lb bags
  Prices (CAD, before tax and shipping): 2 lb $10.49, 5 lb $18.99, 10 lb $37.98, 20 lb $75.96

[basalt-rock-dust] Basalt Rock Dust | NPK Soil amendment | Trace minerals and silica for strong stems
  About: Basalt rock dust is a natural soil amendment made from finely ground volcanic rock, commonly found around the world. It breaks down easily in soil, releasing essential minerals that help replenish nutrients, improve soil health, and support stronger plant growth.
  How to use: Use 1 tbsp (15 ml) per gallon (4 L) for potting, transplanting, or monthly feeding. For living soil, use 1/4 - 3/8 cup (4–6 tbsp) per gallon.
  Sizes: 2 lb (0.9 kg); 5 lb (2.3 kg); 10 lb (4.5 kg) = 2 x 5 lb bags; 20 lb (9.1 kg) = 4 x 5 lb bags
  Prices (CAD, before tax and shipping): 2 lb $11.99, 5 lb $21.99, 10 lb $43.98, 20 lb $87.96

[worm-castings] Worm Castings 1.5-2.5-1.3 | NPK 1.5 - 2.5 - 1.3 | Live biology for any soil
  About: Worm castings are a natural soil amendment produced by earthworms, also known as vermicast. These castings consist of earthworm waste. As worms consume compost materials, their nutrient-rich waste creates a superior soil amendment that supports healthier plant growth.
  How to use: Mix into potting soil or sprinkle around plants. For established plants, use 1–2 cups. Water thoroughly.
  Sizes: 1 L; 1 gallon; 2 gallons; 4 gallons
  Prices (CAD, before tax and shipping): 1 L $6.99, 1 gallon $14.99, 2 gallons $26.99, 4 gallons $49.99

[compost-blend] Compost Blend 0.7-0.3-0.6 | NPK 0.7 - 0.3 - 0.6 | Organic matter that builds humus
  About: Compost is a carefully balanced mixture of organic materials utilized as a plant amendment, improving the physical, chemical, and biological properties of soil. It is typically produced by decomposing plant matter, food waste recycling of organic materials, and various types of manure.
  How to use: Mix 1 part compost with 4 parts soil, or spread on garden beds and lawns. For compost tea, aerate in water for 24–48 hours.
  Sizes: 1 L; 1 gallon; 2 gallons; 4 gallons
  Prices (CAD, before tax and shipping): 1 L $6.99, 1 gallon $12.99, 2 gallons $21.99, 4 gallons $39.99

FAQ
Q: What makes your products different?
A: Low usage rates: Level Up 3-3-3 and Flower Power 2-6-4 use 1 tablespoon per gallon of soil, so a bag goes a long way. The bags are recyclable and reusable, and everything is made locally in Mississauga, Ontario.
Q: Are your products organic?
A: Yes. All products are made from organic ingredients to improve soil health and plant growth, with no synthetic chemicals.
Q: Can beginners use them?
A: Yes. Every bag has clear usage instructions, and the Super Starter Pack is built for new gardeners.
Q: Do they work indoors and outdoors?
A: Yes. They work for indoor and outdoor gardens, year-round.
Q: Can I use them in hydroponic systems?
A: They work in soil-based systems and coco coir setups that include nutrient amendments. They are not suitable for traditional liquid-only hydroponic systems.
Q: Do they change soil pH?
A: Some do. Dolomite lime helps balance pH, while gypsum makes nutrients more available without significantly changing it.
Q: How much of the other amendments should I use?
A: Gypsum: 1–2 tablespoons per gallon of soil or coco. Dolomite lime: 5 lb per 100 sq ft to raise pH by one point. Oyster shell flour: 2.5–5 lb per 100 sq ft, mixed into the top 3 inches of soil.
Q: Can I plant in the empty bag?
A: Yes. The bags are reusable, so you can fill them with soil and plant directly in them.
Q: How long does shipping take?
A: Most orders arrive in 2 to 3 business days. Please allow 2 to 10 business days, depending on the carrier, the weather and where you live. Shipping is a flat rate based on the weight of your order.
Q: Do you ship to the USA?
A: Not at this time. We currently ship within Canada only.
Q: What is your return policy?
A: You have 30 days from receiving an item to request a return. Items must be unused, in their original packaging, with proof of purchase. Email us before sending anything back, because returns without prior authorization are not accepted. Return shipping is paid by the customer. Perishable goods, clearance items and hazardous materials cannot be returned. If an item arrives damaged or incorrect, contact us right away.
